paper_title: SVL: Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning as Survival Learning

claims.claim: SVL reframes goal-conditioned reinforcement learning by modeling time-to-goal as a survival probability distribution rather than learning a value function through TD bootstrapping.
claims.upgrade_gate: Faithful released full architecture and distribution protocol at claim-relevant scale, including twin heads, actors and policy evaluation, or an exact in-scope falsification.

claims.claim: The sparse-reward goal-conditioned value equals the negative discounted sum of survival probabilities.
claims.upgrade_gate: No upgrade needed; preserve and regression-test the exact identity and its scope controls.

claims.claim: The survival-estimator MLE/ERM is consistent and asymptotically normal with statistical fluctuations of order n^(-1/2) under standard conditions.
claims.upgrade_gate: Machine-checkable proof at the lemma's actual scope with explicit assumptions, or a valid-assumption counterexample; a small parametric Monte Carlo alone is insufficient.

claims.claim: HSVL obtains 81 percent success versus 12 percent for HIQL on HumanoidMaze-giant navigation.
claims.upgrade_gate: Preregistered matched HSVL/HIQL four-seed paper-scale training and 50-episode evaluation per seed, or faithful falsification.

claims.claim: HSVL obtains 61 versus 6 percent on visual-AntMaze-giant and 74 versus 65 percent on AntMaze-giant compared with HIQL.
claims.upgrade_gate: Preregistered matched four-seed paper-scale HSVL/HIQL evidence for both conjuncts, or faithful falsification.

claims.claim: With hierarchical extraction removed, flat SVL obtains 45 percent versus 7 percent for re-evaluated CRL using the same DDPG+BC actor.
claims.upgrade_gate: Preregistered matched four-seed flat-SVL/CRL paper-scale training and evaluation with the identical actor, or faithful falsification.
